dog.description_text:
Steel Magnolia is a 9-month-old retriever mix who weighs around 38 lbs and is basically delighted to meet everyone. She’s happy, friendly, affectionate, and always ready for either a play session or a cuddle.

She loves people, does great with other dogs, and has that very social teenage-dog energy where everything feels exciting and worth checking out. She’s also crate-trained and is doing well with the structure that comes with having a routine.

Because she’s still young, Steel Magnolia will do best with adopters who understand that she needs more than just affection. A good mix of exercise, enrichment, training, and consistency will help her thrive and give all that enthusiasm somewhere to go.

Registered adopters interested in Steel Magnolia can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
